title: A Cat and Pam
text: A fat cat sat on a mat. Dad had a hat. He ran fast. Pam had a bag. The cat ran to Pam. Pam had a ham.

title: Ben at the Wet Beach
text: Ben went to the beach. He saw wet sand. Ben had a red net. He saw ten fish. Can he get them? Yes, he can!

title: Kim Sips Milk
text: Kim has a bib. She can sit. Kim will sip milk. It is good. Kim is a kid. She can win!

title: Pat and His Box
text: At school, Pat got a box. It was not a hot box. Pat put a top on it. His pal, Bob, got a mop. Bob will hop and mop. What a fun job!

title: A Wet Day
text: It was a fun day. The sun did not come up. A little bug sat in the mud. Mom gave a hug. We had a cup. We did not run much. It was wet.
